summary: Designed a two-PR release flow: ship only the completed product diff through a checked source PR, tag and publish its merge commit, verify npm/GitHub/clean-install surfaces, then preserve post-publication Empirical evidence in a no-runtime follow-up PR. Accepted decisions require a reviewed merge source, immutable annotated tag before npm, and GitHub release creation only after registry success.
